proposed.choice: Use actor-driven specialist handoffs with one whole-change review gate.
proposed.rationale: Separate responsibility, applicable assessment, authorization and persistence outcome; MOD-018 composition owns the handoff protocol and MOD-017 owns gate semantics. No hosted coordinator is required.
alternatives: Automatic semantic routing in the record store.
consequences: Optional interim advice cannot establish whole-change approval; corrections and proportionate reassessment remain inside the same gate.
Current observed CLI execution is unchanged; this proposed actor protocol does not assert a new service, supported command or implemented skill.
revisit_when: Integrated review changes the allocation or a supported execution boundary is specified.
